instruction: Set up my Yahoo Mail account in Thunderbird using the email "demo.user2024@yahoo.com" and password 'yahoo2024pass' (without quotes). Don't worry about any connection or authentication errors. Just finish the account configuration and I'll check the settings manually later.

metadata.explanation: Task variation for Yahoo Mail account setup in Thunderbird. Uses same evaluator pattern - verifies IMAP (imap.mail.yahoo.com) and SMTP (smtp.mail.yahoo.com) account configurations with correct credentials.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts Thunderbird account configurations using firefox_decrypt.py script to decrypt and export credentials to CSV
Complete coverage: verifies both IMAP and SMTP account configurations, which are both required for a complete mail setup
Expected values are correct: Yahoo Mail servers imap.mail.yahoo.com and smtp.mail.yahoo.com are the proper server addresses
Proper credential verification: checks that username (demo.user2024@yahoo.com) and password (yahoo2024pass) are correctly configured in both accounts
Appropriate use of postconfig: runs extraction script after task completion to capture final account state
Correct metric function: check_csv properly matches CSV records against expected rules using _match_record helper
Logical flow is sound: postconfig extracts data -> check_csv verifies both expected records exist with correct field values
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: Evaluator depends on external firefox_decrypt.py script from GitHub - if URL becomes unavailable or script format changes, verification may fail
Minor concern: CSV format dependency - assumes specific column names (url, user, password) from firefox_decrypt.py output
These are operational robustness concerns rather than semantic logic issues - the verification approach is fundamentally sound
